summary: Record why blocked backup runs and test cleanups are waiting, keep the stalled-run deadline reason on the operation, and fix the documentation records so the docs gate passes.

api.reason: The reason text travels in the existing queued ManagedOutcome error field; no endpoint, field or schema changes.

guide.reason: Operators see Waiting reasons for blocked backups and test cleanups and a kept deadline explanation.

state.reason: The reason is the Core agent journal entry's error field, already reported to the Controller as an outcome.
state.record: Core agent managed-command journal entry error (pool master and member); a fresh Controller re-reads it from the host's reported outcomes.

verification.method: Focused Go tests in internal/agent and the full internal/agent suite; docs gate. No lab run.
